name: Tabs
summary: Panels of one view, one shown at a time.

anatomy.description: A row over the panels, with a line under it.
Text; the selected one has an indicator line.
The content, focusable when it has no focusable content.

variants.description: Arrow keys move focus, Enter selects (panels load).

cues.selected: An indicator line of 3 px on the divider and primary text; not colour alone.
cues.focus-visible: An inset ring, thicker than 2 px and clear of the indicator line, so focus and selection read as two cues.

keyboard.action: Previous or next tab (reversed right to left).
From the tab list to the panel.

a11y.name: The tab list has a label; each panel is labelled by its tab.
notes: Tabs that navigate between pages are a navigation, not tabs.
